info.title: School Management System API
info.description:
REST API for managing students, teachers, classes, timetables and grades.

Log in with `POST /api/auth/login` (test accounts are listed in the README), then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

email.description: Case-insensitive: it is trimmed and lower-cased before lookup.

registrationNumber.description: Number in the school register (nr. matricol).

class.description: Null when the student is not assigned to a class yet.

message.description: A message, or a list of validation messages.

registrationNumber.description:
Number in the school register (număr matricol): year of enrollment and
number in that year, given automatically.

class.description: Null when the student is not assigned to a class.

classId.description: Class to enroll the student in. Omit or send null to leave unassigned.

password.description: Initial password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
Initial password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.

classId.description: Class to enroll the student in. Omit or send null to leave unassigned.

homeroomClasses.description: Classes where this teacher is the homeroom teacher (diriginte).

password.description: Initial password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
Initial password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.

id.description: Teacher or student id (not the user id).

teacher.description: Null while nobody is assigned to teach it.

subjects.description: Subjects studied by the class and who teaches each one.

homeroomTeacherId.description: Homeroom teacher (diriginte). Omit or send null for none.
Homeroom teacher (diriginte). Omit or send null for none.

studentIds.description: Students to move into the class (they leave their current class, if any).

teacherId.description: Teacher of this subject in this class. Omit or send null to leave it vacant.
New teacher, or null to make the subject vacant.

hoursPerWeek.description: Lessons per week (1-10). Can't go below the lessons already in the timetable.

removeLessonIds.description:
Lessons of this subject to take out of the timetable first, in the same
transaction (resolves an HOURS_BELOW_SCHEDULED conflict).

teacher.description: Null while the subject has no teacher.

classSubjectId.description: The subject of the class to schedule (see the class details).

replaceLessonId.description:
Resolves a CLASS_SLOT_TAKEN conflict: removes this lesson of the class
(it must be in the same slot) and adds the new one, in one transaction.

increaseHours.description:
Resolves a WEEKLY_HOURS_FULL conflict: when every weekly hour of the
subject is already scheduled, adds one more hour (up to 10).

TimetableConflictType.description:
- CLASS_SLOT_TAKEN: the class already has a lesson in the slot (`lessons[0]`).
- TEACHER_BUSY: the teacher teaches another class then (`lessons`).
- WEEKLY_HOURS_FULL: all weekly hours of the subject are scheduled (`lessons`).
- HOURS_BELOW_SCHEDULED: fewer weekly hours than lessons in the timetable (`lessons`).

type.description:
- CLASS_SLOT_TAKEN: the class already has a lesson in the slot (`lessons[0]`).
- TEACHER_BUSY: the teacher teaches another class then (`lessons`).
- WEEKLY_HOURS_FULL: all weekly hours of the subject are scheduled (`lessons`).
- HOURS_BELOW_SCHEDULED: fewer weekly hours than lessons in the timetable (`lessons`).

day.description: The slot that was asked for (slot conflicts).

lessons.description: The lessons involved in the conflict.

classSubjectId.description: The subject of the class (hours conflicts).

message.description: A message, or a list of validation messages.

swap.description:
Resolves a CLASS_SLOT_TAKEN conflict: the lesson already in the new slot
takes this lesson's old slot (both teachers are checked).

replaceLessonId.description:
Resolves a CLASS_SLOT_TAKEN conflict the other way: removes the lesson
that is in the new slot (it must be the one in that slot).

teacher.description: Current teacher of the subject in the student's class.

roundedAverage.description: Average rounded to a whole grade (.50 rounds up).

minimumGrades.description: Weekly hours + 1. Null if the subject isn't taught in the student's current class.

hasMinimumGrades.description: Whether the student has at least the minimum number of grades.

registrationNumber.description: Number in the school register (nr. matricol).

subjects.description: Every subject of the class (and any other subject the student has grades in).

overallAverage.description:
Mean of the rounded subject averages, two decimals, truncated.
Null until every subject has at least one grade.

teacher.description: Who gave the grade. Null if that teacher was deleted.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or earlier. Defaults to today.

Date of this grade (YYYY-MM-DD, today or earlier), e.g. from a
spreadsheet. Defaults to the date of the batch.

replaceGradeId.description:
Replace this existing grade of the student in the subject (value and
date change, the history keeps the old ones) instead of adding a new one.
Teachers can only replace grades they gave.

subjectId.description: The subject every grade in the batch is for.

date.description: Date of every grade in the batch: YYYY-MM-DD, today or earlier. Defaults to today.

grades.description: One grade per student; a student can appear only once.

count.description: Number of grades saved (created or replaced).

replaced.description: How many of them replaced an existing grade.

gradeIds.description: Ids of the saved grades, in the order they were sent.

changedBy.description: Null if that account was deleted.

registrationNumber.description: The student's number in the school register (nr. matricol).

status.description: "read" when the photo was read, "failed" when it could not be.

index.description: Position of the photo in the upload, from 0.

error.description: Why the photo could not be read.

student.description: The student the test belongs to, if found in the class.

studentNameRead.description: The name as written on the test.

gradeRead.description: The grade as written on the test, possibly with decimals.

grade.description: The grade to give: a whole number from 1 to 10.

readBy.description: The model that read this photo (a fallback model if the main one was busy).

mode.description: "ai" when an AI model read the photos, "demo" when the results are simulated.

model.description: The AI model that read the photos.

tests.description: One entry per photo, in upload order. Nothing is saved yet.

registrationNumber.description: Number in the school register (nr. matricol).

rowNumber.description: Row number in the spreadsheet, as Excel shows it.

classRead.description: The class as written in the file.

registrationNumberRead.description: The registration number as written in the file.

studentNameRead.description: The student as written in the file.

gradeRead.description: The grade as written in the file.

grade.description: The grade to give: a whole number from 1 to 10.

date.description: The date from the file (YYYY-MM-DD), or null to use the date chosen on the page.

student.description: The student the row belongs to, if found.

classes.description: The classes of the import: the one asked for, or every class where the user can grade the subject.

students.description: Every student of those classes, to fix a row matched to the wrong student.

rows.description: Rows with a grade, in file order. Nothing is saved yet.

skippedRows.description: Rows without a grade (students who weren't graded), left out.

link.description: The page of the app it is about.

count.description: How many notifications were marked as read.

sender.description: Null if the sender's account was deleted.

lastReadAt.description: Everything up to this moment was read; null = nothing yet.

name.description: The group's name, or the other person's name in a direct conversation.

unreadCount.description: Messages from others the user hasn't read.

userId.description: The user (not student or teacher id) to talk to.

memberIds.description: Users to add, besides the creator (at least one).
